metadata.title: Niraparib and Abiraterone acetate (Akeega®) and Prednisolone Therapy
metadata.indication: BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer when chemotherapy is not clinically indicated.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled draft; independent approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and product information reconciled for this release; declared discrepancies and independent review remain outstanding.

source_discrepancies: Current EMA indication also includes BRCA-mutated mHSPC with prednisolone 5 mg/day. NCCP 00848 v2 remains mCRPC with 10 mg/day; no automatic indication or reimbursement expansion.
NCCP/SmPC severe hepatotoxicity includes ALT or AST 20 ×ULN; the encoded stop includes equality.
The SmPC adds a permanent stop when haematological toxicity fails to recover within 28 days; this supplements NCCP recurrence tables.

action.message: Grade 1: no dose change; consider weekly counts.

rules.explanation: Grade 1: no dose change; consider weekly counts.

action.message: Grade 2 neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: at least weekly counts; consider holding until grade 1/baseline, then weekly counts for 28 days.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: at least weekly counts; consider holding until grade 1/baseline, then weekly counts for 28 days.

action.message: Hold Akeega; at least weekly counts until grade 1/baseline. First event may resume the same dose or two 50/500 mg tablets if warranted. Confirm history and authorisation.

rules.explanation: Hold Akeega; at least weekly counts until grade 1/baseline. First event may resume the same dose or two 50/500 mg tablets if warranted. Confirm history and authorisation.

action.message: Second grade 3+ neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: hold until grade 1, then two 50/500 mg tablets daily if authorised; if already at that dose consider discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Second grade 3+ neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: hold until grade 1, then two 50/500 mg tablets daily if authorised; if already at that dose consider discontinuation.

action.message: Third grade 3+ neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: permanently discontinue Akeega.

rules.explanation: Third grade 3+ neutropenia/thrombocytopenia: permanently discontinue Akeega.

action.message: Interrupt Akeega and provide supportive management for intolerable haematological toxicity.

rules.explanation: Interrupt Akeega and provide supportive management for intolerable haematological toxicity.

action.message: Haematological toxicity has not recovered to acceptable levels within 28 days of interruption: permanently discontinue Akeega.

rules.explanation: Haematological toxicity has not recovered to acceptable levels within 28 days of interruption: permanently discontinue Akeega.

action.message: Grade 1 anaemia: no dose change; consider weekly monitoring.

rules.explanation: Grade 1 anaemia: no dose change; consider weekly monitoring.

action.message: Grade 2 anaemia from baseline grade 0-1: at least weekly counts for 28 days.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 anaemia from baseline grade 0-1: at least weekly counts for 28 days.

action.message: Hold Akeega, provide support and check counts at least weekly until anaemia grade 2 or better; persistent anaemia may need dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Hold Akeega, provide support and check counts at least weekly until anaemia grade 2 or better; persistent anaemia may need dose reduction.

action.message: Second grade 3+ anaemia: hold until grade 2 or better, then two 50/500 mg tablets if authorised. If already reduced, consider discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Second grade 3+ anaemia: hold until grade 2 or better, then two 50/500 mg tablets if authorised. If already reduced, consider discontinuation.

action.message: Third grade 3+ anaemia: consider discontinuation using clinical judgement; this is not the automatic third-event stop used for neutropenia/thrombocytopenia.

rules.explanation: Third grade 3+ anaemia: consider discontinuation using clinical judgement; this is not the automatic third-event stop used for neutropenia/thrombocytopenia.

action.message: Confirm current strength and recurrence. Do not reduce both agents as if all dose reductions were identical; a further haematological reduction requires consideration of stopping.

rules.explanation: Confirm current strength and recurrence. Do not reduce both agents as if all dose reductions were identical; a further haematological reduction requires consideration of stopping.

action.message: Interrupt Akeega and treat the event; do not restart before grade 1/baseline and authorised review.

rules.explanation: Interrupt Akeega and treat the event; do not restart before grade 1/baseline and authorised review.

action.message: ALT or AST above 5 ×ULN: hold and investigate. Only after return to own baseline may one 100/500 mg tablet daily be considered; monitor every two weeks for three months then monthly.

rules.explanation: ALT or AST above 5 ×ULN: hold and investigate. Only after return to own baseline may one 100/500 mg tablet daily be considered; monitor every two weeks for three months then monthly.

action.message: ALT or AST reaches 20 ×ULN: permanently discontinue. NCCP and SmPC include exactly 20 ×ULN; later SmPC wording also uses >20, so the explicit 20-times criterion is retained.

rules.explanation: ALT or AST reaches 20 ×ULN: permanently discontinue. NCCP and SmPC include exactly 20 ×ULN; later SmPC wording also uses >20, so the explicit 20-times criterion is retained.

action.message: Concurrent ALT >3 ×ULN and bilirubin >2 ×ULN without another cause: permanently discontinue. AST alone must not substitute for ALT in this rule.

rules.explanation: Concurrent ALT >3 ×ULN and bilirubin >2 ×ULN without another cause: permanently discontinue. AST alone must not substitute for ALT in this rule.

action.message: Concurrent ALT/bilirubin elevation: hold and urgently investigate alternative causes. Permanent-stop attribution requires exclusion of other causes.

administration.dose: 200 mg/1000 mg once daily (two 100 mg/500 mg tablets)
administration.instructions: Swallow whole with water at least two hours after food; do not eat for at least one hour afterwards. If missed, take as soon as possible on the same day; no extra dose. Do not interchange the two strengths.

dose_reductions.haematological: Two 50 mg/500 mg tablets once daily; second reduction consider discontinuation.
dose_reductions.hepatotoxicity: One 100 mg/500 mg tablet once daily; second reduction discontinue.

treatment.additional_requirement: Continue GnRH analogue unless surgically castrated.
treatment.duration_text: Continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity
treatment.schedule_summary: Akeega two 100/500 mg tablets once daily fasting plus prednisolone 10 mg daily with food; continue ADT unless surgically castrated.

eligibility: mCRPC with germline and/or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation

regular: FBC weekly in month 1, every two weeks in months 2-3, monthly for the remainder of year 1, then every two months
ALT/AST and bilirubin every two weeks in months 1-3, monthly for the remainder of year 1, then every two months
After starting two 50/500 mg tablets following interruption: liver tests every two weeks for six weeks
Blood pressure weekly for first two months, then monthly for year 1, then every two months
Potassium monthly for year 1, then every two months; renal profile and glucose as clinically indicated
Monitor oedema/weight and heart failure symptoms every two weeks for three months, then monthly in those at cardiac risk
After restarting/reducing for cytopenia: weekly counts for 28 days; specific hepatic rechallenge schedule is separate

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Akeega is classified as oral moderate-high emetogenic risk.
supportive_care.premedications: Not usually required; consider prophylactic antiemetics for the first 2 weeks as clinically indicated.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
